description.narrative:
Increase access to affordable housing finance: IFC anticipates that the Project will support Grihum in increasing access to affordable housing finance and thus help address the significant housing shortage in the country.
Competitiveness: The proposed project is the first project under IFC's systematic approach to developing the RMBS to address the significant housing financing gap in India. IFC anticipates the Project, along with other projects under the systematic approach, will promote greater competitiveness in the securitization market by supporting the development of RMBS, which will be key for increasing access to housing finance in India.

The proposed IFC investment comprises an INR denominated investment of up to INR 5.6 billion (approximately US$65 million equivalent) in securitized assets originated by Grihum Housing Finance Limited (Grihum), through subscription to Pass Through Certificates (PTC) backed by individual housing loans, known as Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities (RMBS), with a tenor of up to 8 years. As part of the project, IFC will explore mobilizing an aggregate amount of INR 860 million (approximately US$10 million equivalent) from other institutional investors who subscribe to the RMBS. The entire proceeds from the investment will be directed by Grihum towards expanding its affordable housing finance portfolio.
